description: In front of you on the table is an open black hard case with foam cutouts, along with a gray oval item, two small clear jars with white lids, a small white duck, and a fuzzy yellow toy. The left hand stays resting on the table while the right hand picks up the gray oval item and lowers it into the large foam slot in the open case, then lifts and places the two small jars into the round cutouts, adds the white duck, and finally drops the fuzzy yellow toy into the case before letting go.
